# Swift Web Sync

> Swift Web Sync is a digital growth agency specializing in high-performance, mobile-first web development and digital infrastructure for US small businesses, including restaurants, salons, contractors, and studios. We replace slow, vulnerable legacy platforms with lightning-fast static web applications.

## Core Offerings & Pricing
- **Custom Static Web Build:** $500 total build fee (50% deposit, 50% final balance upon launch).
- **Managed Retainer:** $49/month covering high-performance cloud hosting, SSL security, domain maintenance, and regular content updates.
- **Turnaround:** Rapid 48-hour delivery model backed by consultative value-selling.
